criteria.text: A created note has an id, title, body, tags and createdAt.
listNotes returns notes sorted by createdAt descending.
The returned array is a copy, not the store.
listNotes(store, { tag }) returns only notes carrying that tag.
exportMarkdown(store) returns one '## title' section per note with the body below it.
The page at / shows 'N notes' where N is the number of notes in the store.
